name: Superside
long_description:
Superside is an AI-native creative agency. We partner with enterprise technology companies to push the frontier of agentic creative. We are proud to be working with brands we love, like Reddit, Wikipedia, Microsoft, xAI and Mozilla, and many others, as well as hundreds of startups and small companies using our self-serve platform.

AI can make a decent image in seconds. It can't make an effective campaign yet. Getting from one to the other still takes a lot of people and a lot of plumbing, and we think that will be true for a while. So we work on three things.

Systems. Our forward-deployed engineers, creative technologists and creatives work with a customer's marketing team and build the production line: one idea in, hundreds of on-brand variants out, across markets and formats.

Platform. Agents for competitor research, concepting and ad generation, plus Brand Brain, which holds each brand's rules and past work, all connected to the customer's own systems through MCP.

Creative. AI-native creative directors from the world's leading agencies and in-house teams. AI raises everyone to the floor. Humans still lift the ceiling and drive better performance.

Superside is fully remote and has delivered more than 200,000 creative projects, which are now the evals for our agents.

Investors include Y Combinator, Sam Altman, John Collison, Paul Buchheit and Geoff Ralston, plus Luxor Capital, Prosus Ventures, Freestyle Capital, Slack Fund, High Alpha and Alliance Ventures.
